effects.reference: Unablated epistemic engine with configured VOI acquisition.
effects.use_premise_graph: Use iterative relevance baseline: removes decomposition and downstream evidence-state/formal/VOI control; raw context.
effects.use_belief_state: Use premise-only baseline: retains decomposition, replaces belief/formal/conflict/VOI control with a model judge; raw context.
effects.use_formal_sufficiency: Retain evidence/beliefs; replace proof sufficiency and frontier/VOI target selection with a generative controller.
effects.use_conflict_resolution: Retain MIXED and conservative sufficiency; replace conflict-resolution actions/queries with ordinary targeted search.
effects.use_cost_aware_controller: Replace VOI ranking with importance; preserve frontier, conflict priority and hard budgets.
effects.allow_abstention: Attempt a cited best answer at policy abstention or round limit; hard budget/errors still stop, null outputs remain failures.
effects.compact_evidence: Supply full retrieved document text to the final answer model; retain extracted ledger and control policy.

limitations: Matched ceilings, not equal realized resource usage.
Removing prerequisite components also removes dependent control; see effects.
Interventions may be inactive on easy cases; inspect traces before attributing effects.
Variant order is recorded; exact-request cache reuse couples results and latency.
Incomplete runs and model failures stay in reports; no automatic benchmark scaling.
